test_request_cache_store_and_fetch: test the RequestCache class by storing and fetching cached inference results from a sqlite-backed cache
create_request_cache_instance: create a RequestCache instance with a local checkpoint directory for storing inference request results
initialize_request_cache: initialize a RequestCache with a rank to set up the sqlite database and async writer loop
store_inference_result: store an inference result in the RequestCache with chunk index, doc id, rollout index, and payload hash
retrieve_cached_response: retrieve a cached inference response from RequestCache using doc id, rollout index, and payload hash
store_inference_error: store an inference error message in the RequestCache for a failed request identified by doc id and payload hash
flush_request_cache: flush the RequestCache to ensure all queued write operations are committed to the sqlite database
drop_cached_chunk: drop a chunk of cached entries from RequestCache by chunk index
mark_document_complete: mark a document as complete in RequestCache so subsequent lookups return no cached data
close_request_cache: close the RequestCache connection and optionally delete the sqlite database file
